title: Language Configuration
description: Per-language configuration for source_kit. Includes comments, brackets, and indentation heuristics.

comments.description: Comment syntax for the language (used for comment toggling and auto-continue)

line.description: Line comment prefix(es). Can be a string or array (e.g., '//', '#', ['//','#'])

doc.description: Doc comment prefix (e.g., '///' for Dart/Rust). When pressing Enter on a doc comment line, this prefix is auto-continued.

blockContinuation.description: Text to insert when continuing a block comment on a new line (e.g., ' * '). Pressing Enter inside /* */ adds this prefix.

lists.description: List marker syntax for languages like Markdown (used for list continuation on Enter)

unorderedMarkers.description: Unordered list markers (e.g., ['-', '*', '+']). Pressing Enter on a list item continues with the same marker.

orderedPattern.description: Regex pattern for ordered list markers (e.g., '^(\\d+)\\.\\s' for '1. '). Capture group 1 is the number to increment.

checkboxUnchecked.description: Unchecked checkbox marker (e.g., '- [ ] '). Pressing Enter on a task list item adds an unchecked box.

checkboxChecked.description: Checked checkbox marker (e.g., '- [x] '). Used to detect task list items.

brackets.description: Bracket pairs for matching, highlighting, and auto-close

autoClose.description: Whether to auto-insert the closing bracket when opening is typed

newline.description: Whether pressing Enter between these brackets should add an indented line

autoCloseBefore.description: Characters before which auto-close is allowed (cursor must be before one of these)

indentation.description: Fallback indentation heuristics (used when parser lags behind typing)

blockOpeners.description: Tokens at END of line that increase indent on next line

lineStartBlockOpeners.description: Tokens at START of line that increase indent (Lisp-family languages)

keywordOpeners.description: Keywords at END of line that increase indent (e.g., 'do', 'then')

lineStartKeywords.description: Keywords at START of line that increase indent (e.g., 'def', 'class')

colonOpensBlock.description: Whether ':' at end of line increases indent (Python, YAML)

dedentPairs.description: Paired delimiters for heuristic dedent (when AST is stale). Default: [{open: '{', close: '}'}, {open: '(', close: ')'}, {open: '[', close: ']'}]
